name: co.computrabajo.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.
lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain read; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome. Partial analysis: 90 of 90 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. co.computrabajo.com scores 68 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 20 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: plain http serves the site without redirecting.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 2 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Links must be distinguishable without relying on color
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /, for example a[href$="prestaciondeservicio/"]. Impact: serious.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Microsoft Clarity (2 requests).
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The TLS certificate is valid for 90 more days
Every image has an alt attribute
The largest element paints in 0.5 s
Every page has a meta description
Language alternates point at each other
